streamer.state: The image is the full-height LEFT HALF of a PvP matchup introduction from The Bazaar. It contains the streamer hero artwork and its identity-color glow or blur at the BOTTOM-LEFT corner. Identify the ONE illustrated hero using the character descriptions and the identity glow. Ignore the real webcam person, usernames, titles and rank badges. Identify the underlying hero, allowing cosmetic skins. Never infer identity from the person, username or game items. Corner identity glow colors: Dooley = orange; Vanessa = red; The Dragons = teal; Pygmalien = blue; Jules = pink; Mak = green; Stelle = yellow; Karnok = magenta. The corner glow is a UI identity cue, distinct from clothing color and the central background. If the corner is covered by a webcam or overlay, use visible character artwork; do not invent a hidden glow.

hero.instructions: Which underlying hero is depicted in this single screen half? Select one hero. Cosmetic skins preserve hero identity.

criteria.Dooley: A small, rounded robot with a single large circular eye, mechanical limbs, and orange and grey coloring.
criteria.Vanessa: A female pirate with dark hair, sharp facial features, a slim athletic build, and red coloring.
criteria.The Dragons: Two youthful, horned, pointed-eared humanoid musicians, a singer and a guitarist, with purple and pink coloring.
criteria.Pygmalien: A large, broad-built humanoid boar with a pig snout, protruding lower tusks, pointed ears, facial hair, and blue coloring.
criteria.Jules: A four-armed, pointed-eared female chef with long hair and pink coloring.
criteria.Mak: A male alchemist with an angular face, a full beard, thick eyebrows, and green coloring.
criteria.Stelle: A dark-skinned female engineer and aviator with reddish-brown hair, goggles, and yellow coloring.
criteria.Karnok: A rugged male hunter with an angular face and dark fur, also appearing as a large, shaggy, fanged beast. His primary colors are magenta and black.

identity_visibility.instructions: Inspect the actual visibility of the ILLUSTRATED GAME CHARACTER, separately from guessing its hero identity. Is a webcam, camera rectangle, text panel, opaque mask or other overlay covering the character's head/face or its main identity-bearing illustrated anatomy? A recognizable remaining snout, beard, hand or costume does not make a partly hidden head fully clear. Ignore real webcam people as the target. Clothing, cosmetic skins, hats, hoods, gloves, poses and objects drawn as part of the illustration are not external obstruction by themselves. An overlay confined to background, username/nameplate, lower legs or the corner UI/glow is not head/face or principal identity-art obstruction if the illustrated head/face and identifying anatomy are visible. Legitimate corner identity glow can remain valid hero evidence even when the head/art is covered; glow visibility or a confident hero answer does NOT mean the illustrated art is uncovered. Do not infer visibility from hero-choice confidence or make visibility agree with identity. Despite any intro assumption in the surrounding identification context, inspect these pixels: if they show a dissolve, gameplay or another non-intro scene, choose transition_or_not_intro; if the main artwork is hidden by a cover choose fully_covered; if you cannot establish coverage choose uncertain.

criteria.clear: The illustrated character's head/face and main identity-bearing art are visible without an external overlay covering them. Minor overlays limited to background, nameplate, lower legs or corner glow alone do not invalidate clear head/main identity art.
criteria.partly_covered: A webcam or external overlay covers part of the illustrated head/face or a substantial principal identity-bearing art region, even if the hero remains recognizable from remaining anatomy or legitimate glow.
criteria.fully_covered: The main illustrated character/head/identity-bearing artwork is completely or almost completely hidden by an external cover; small remaining corner glow/UI fragments may still be visible.
criteria.transition_or_not_intro: Visible dissolve, fade or mixed gameplay/intro layers, or a recognizable gameplay/other non-intro scene instead of a stable large-portrait introduction.
criteria.uncertain: Insufficient or ambiguous visible evidence to determine whether the character head/face/main identity-bearing artwork is clear, partly covered or fully covered, or whether it is an intro.
